title: no-throw overrides
description: Colors code you did not write, from a project you do. `nothrow.overrides.json` sits at your project root, beside its `package.json`, and outranks every other carrier — it is the rung nobody else has to act for you. Each value is the manifest shape minus `files` and `package`: hashes are about a package's own bytes, and the package these colors are about is the key.

version.description: Bumped only on a breaking reinterpretation. A version this reader does not know floors the whole file.

packages.description: npm package name to the colors asserted for it.

modules.description: Ambient module specifier to the colors asserted for what that `declare module` block declares. The address for everything no package entry point publishes — `node:path` and its siblings among them.
